dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「えっ、じゃあ、本当にさくらちゃん先生になっ
　ちゃったの？」
dialogues.en: "So, you really became a teacher?"
dialogues.text: "So, you really became a teacher?"

dialogues.jp: ソファーから身を起こして音夢が驚く。
dialogues.en: Nemu's surprised as she gets up from the couch.
dialogues.text: Nemu's surprised as she gets up from the couch.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「Ｙｅｓ！」
dialogues.en: "All right!"
dialogues.text: "All right!"

dialogues.jp:
台所で鍋を温めながら、さくらが鼻歌がまじり
そうな勢いで頷いていた。
dialogues.en:
Sakura nods, humming a tune and warming the pot in the
kitchen.
dialogues.text:
Sakura nods, humming a tune and warming the pot in the
kitchen.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うわぁ、すごい、法律ってどうなってるの？」
dialogues.en: "Whoa, what about the regulation?"
dialogues.text: "Whoa, what about the regulation?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お前、現実的だな……」
dialogues.en: "You're so practical."
dialogues.text: "You're so practical."

dialogues.jp:
向かいのソファーで料理の匂いに空腹を覚えつ
つ、小さくため息をつく。
dialogues.en: I give a little sigh while feeling hungry on the couch.
dialogues.text: I give a little sigh while feeling hungry on the couch.

dialogues.jp:
さくらのお祝いをしてやろうと思って呼んだの
だが、いかんせん、主催者の俺がだるくなって
いる。
dialogues.en:
I invited Sakura to the celebration, but I, as the host, am
already getting tired.
dialogues.text:
I invited Sakura to the celebration, but I, as the host, am
already getting tired.

dialogues.jp:
と言うか、主催者側が食事を作れず、祝われる
さくらが料理している時点で終わっている気が
しなくもない。
dialogues.en:
The host can't cook, so the guest of honor is cooking.
There's something wrong with that picture, isn't there?
dialogues.text:
The host can't cook, so the guest of honor is cooking.
There's something wrong with that picture, isn't there?

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、俺がだらけているのは音夢のハイテンショ
ンのせいだろう。
dialogues.en:
The reason why I feel lazy is because Nemu is hyper, I
think.
dialogues.text:
The reason why I feel lazy is because Nemu is hyper, I
think.

dialogues.jp:
周囲に盛り上がった人間がいると、誰かが代わ
りに冷静になるという現象だ……なにかの本で
読んだ。
dialogues.en:
I read about this phenomenon in a book, which said that when
one person's extremely upbeat, the other becomes quiet.
dialogues.text:
I read about this phenomenon in a book, which said that when
one person's extremely upbeat, the other becomes quiet.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「だって、同い年の講師なんて普通いないよ！？
　新聞とかテレビが来るかな？」
dialogues.en:
"Normally, a teacher isn't the same age as their students!
It'll be big news on TV, don't you think?"
dialogues.text:
"Normally, a teacher isn't the same age as their students!
It'll be big news on TV, don't you think?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「｛うち／風見｝がいつから普通になったんだよ……元よ
　り私学だから関係ないだろう」
dialogues.en:
"Since when has Kazami Academy been normal? This is a
private school, so I think it doesn't matter."
dialogues.text:
"Since when has Kazami Academy been normal? This is a
private school, so I think it doesn't matter."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうだけどさぁ、でも、普通じゃないよ？」
dialogues.en: "I know that, but it's not right."
dialogues.text: "I know that, but it's not right."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あくまでゲスト講師ってことで押し通してる
　みたいだけど？」
dialogues.en: "Apparently they'll keep me around as a guest teacher."
dialogues.text: "Apparently they'll keep me around as a guest teacher."

dialogues.jp:
ことこと、と皿を並べてさくらもソファーにつ
く。
dialogues.en:
Sakura puts the plates on the table and sits down on the
couch.
dialogues.text:
Sakura puts the plates on the table and sits down on the
couch.

dialogues.jp:
品目はご飯と味噌汁、焼き魚など、パーティー
には不向きなものだが、さくらが自由に料理し
ている時点で文句はない。
dialogues.en:
The menu is steamed rice, miso soup and grilled fish.
They're not exactly party food, but I have no complaints
because Sakura cooked them.
dialogues.text:
The menu is steamed rice, miso soup and grilled fish.
They're not exactly party food, but I have no complaints
because Sakura cooked them.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うわぁ、生じゃない魚だぁ♪」
dialogues.en: "Whoa, that's not a raw fish."
dialogues.text: "Whoa, that's not a raw fish."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん、美味そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, it looks delicious."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, it looks delicious."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……あ、あのさ、ふたりとも焼き魚くらい作
　れるよね？」
dialogues.en: "Uh..., you can at least grill a fish, can't you?"
dialogues.text: "Uh..., you can at least grill a fish, can't you?"

dialogues.jp: さくらが首をかしげる。
dialogues.en: Sakura tilts her head.
dialogues.text: Sakura tilts her head.

dialogues.jp: 「俺は魚を黒くするのが得意だ」
dialogues.en: "I'm good at burning fishes."
dialogues.text: "I'm good at burning fishes."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「私が魚を焼くと、どうしても家中が煙だらけ
　になるの。消防車を呼ばれちゃうでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"When I grill a fish, the house gets filled with smoke. We
don't want to bother the firefighters, do we?"
dialogues.text:
"When I grill a fish, the house gets filled with smoke. We
don't want to bother the firefighters, do we?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「味噌汁は薄くなるか濃くなるかだな」
dialogues.en: "My miso soup is always too thin or too thick."
dialogues.text: "My miso soup is always too thin or too thick."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「う〜……あ、でもご飯はちゃんと炊けるよう
　になったよ私♪」
dialogues.en: "Um... But, I can cook delicious rice."
dialogues.text: "Um... But, I can cook delicious rice."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うむ。成長したな俺達も」
dialogues.en: "Hm, we improved, didn't we?"
dialogues.text: "Hm, we improved, didn't we?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あにゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Anyaa..."
dialogues.text: "Anyaa..."

dialogues.speaker: Junichi, Nemu & Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いただきま〜す」
dialogues.en: "Let's eat!"
dialogues.text: "Let's eat!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ご馳走様でした」
dialogues.en: "Thank you for the food."
dialogues.text: "Thank you for the food."

dialogues.jp: 一番最後に音夢が箸を置いて手を合わせる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu finishes last, and she puts down the chopsticks to join
her hands together.
dialogues.text:
Nemu finishes last, and she puts down the chopsticks to join
her hands together.

dialogues.jp: 「うむ」
dialogues.en: "Hm."
dialogues.text: "Hm."

dialogues.jp:
久しぶりに、電子レンジ以外で加熱した食品を
食べた。
dialogues.en:
It's been a while since we ate real home-made food. Our
usual cooking method is a microwave oven.
dialogues.text:
It's been a while since we ate real home-made food. Our
usual cooking method is a microwave oven.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お粗末様でした。ちょっと多めに作ったから、
　音夢ちゃん明日のお昼にでも食べて食べて♪」
dialogues.en:
"I hope you enjoyed my food, anyway. I made more than
enough, so please eat the rest of it for lunch tomorrow,
Nemu-chan."
dialogues.text:
"I hope you enjoyed my food, anyway. I made more than
enough, so please eat the rest of it for lunch tomorrow,
Nemu-chan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん。ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "Okay, thanks."
dialogues.text: "Okay, thanks."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、デザートでも作りますか」
dialogues.en: "Well then, let's make some dessert."
dialogues.text: "Well then, let's make some dessert."

dialogues.jp: 拳を握ってふたりに見せる。
dialogues.en: I make a fist and show it to them.
dialogues.text: I make a fist and show it to them.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、さっぱりしたものがいいな」
dialogues.en: "I'd like something light."
dialogues.text: "I'd like something light."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクも〜」
dialogues.en: "Me too."
dialogues.text: "Me too."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ん、そうか？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.jp: 少し考えて、あるモノに挑戦しようと思った。
dialogues.en: Thinking for a little while, I decide what I should make.
dialogues.text: Thinking for a little while, I decide what I should make.

dialogues.jp:
ご飯茶碗をひきよせて、その上で手を軽く握り
ながらイメージを浮かべる。
dialogues.en:
I move my rice bowl out of the way, trying to get the image
of it by squeezing my hand over it.
dialogues.text:
I move my rice bowl out of the way, trying to get the image
of it by squeezing my hand over it.

dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん」
いまいち細部を想像しづらい和菓子だ。
dialogues.en: This Japanese snack is very hard to imagine precisely.
dialogues.text: This Japanese snack is very hard to imagine precisely.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん……なに作ってるの？」
dialogues.en: "What are you going to make, niisan?"
dialogues.text: "What are you going to make, niisan?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Hm."
dialogues.text: "Hm."

dialogues.jp:
と、手の中にニュルニュルとした感覚が生まれ
る。
dialogues.en: And then, I feel something slimy in my hands.
dialogues.text: And then, I feel something slimy in my hands.

dialogues.jp: 「くずきり」
dialogues.en: "Cold noodles."
dialogues.text: "Cold noodles."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「流しに捨ててきなさい！」
dialogues.en: "Throw them in the sink!"
dialogues.text: "Throw them in the sink!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Okay..."
dialogues.text: "Okay..."

dialogues.jp:
なんだか俺も、手のひらを開くのが怖くてその
まま台所にくずきりを捨てにいった。
dialogues.en:
Feeling terrified to open my hand, I walk straight to the
sink to throw them away.
dialogues.text:
Feeling terrified to open my hand, I walk straight to the
sink to throw them away.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「でもさ、どうして先生になりたかったの？」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, why did you want to be a teacher?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, why did you want to be a teacher?"

dialogues.jp:
帰ってくると話題が変わっていた。多分、くず
きりよりは無難な話なのだろう。
dialogues.en:
When I come back, the topic's changed. It must be a better
subject than cold noodles.
dialogues.text:
When I come back, the topic's changed. It must be a better
subject than cold noodles.

dialogues.jp: 「夢だったんだって」
dialogues.en: "That was her dream."
dialogues.text: "That was her dream."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Dream?"
dialogues.text: "Dream?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだよ」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「音夢だって看護師になりたいって黙ってただ
　ろうが」
dialogues.en: "You didn't tell us that you wanted to be a nurse, did you?"
dialogues.text: "You didn't tell us that you wanted to be a nurse, did you?"

dialogues.jp: ソファーに座りなおして呟く。
dialogues.en: I say, sitting down on the couch again.
dialogues.text: I say, sitting down on the couch again.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「わっ！」
dialogues.en: "Waaah!"
dialogues.text: "Waaah!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうなの音夢ちゃん♪　白衣の天使様♪」
dialogues.en: "Is that true, Nemu-chan? An angel in white..."
dialogues.text: "Is that true, Nemu-chan? An angel in white..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「やめてよふたりとも。夢とかじゃなくて、な
　りたいかな――って思ってるぐらいのものな
　んだから」
dialogues.en:
"Stop it, guys. It's not a dream -- well, it's a kind of
wish."
dialogues.text:
"Stop it, guys. It's not a dream -- well, it's a kind of
wish."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「なれるなれる！　音夢ちゃんなら絶対にいい
　看護師さんになれるよ！」
dialogues.en: "You can do it! You could be a great nurse for sure!"
dialogues.text: "You can do it! You could be a great nurse for sure!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ま、料理人よりはマシだな」
dialogues.en: "Well, it's better than becoming a chef."
dialogues.text: "Well, it's better than becoming a chef."

dialogues.jp:
ぼそり、と呟いて、少々おきすぎてしまった急
須からお茶を注ぐ。
dialogues.en: Muttering, I pour the tea from the teapot.
dialogues.text: Muttering, I pour the tea from the teapot.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「う〜……あ、でも、さくらはどうして先生に
　なりたくなったの？」
dialogues.en: "Uhhh... why did you want to become a teacher, Sakura?"
dialogues.text: "Uhhh... why did you want to become a teacher, Sakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「夢だからだろ？」
dialogues.en: "She said it was her dream, didn't she?"
dialogues.text: "She said it was her dream, didn't she?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「原因だよ。なんか好きだったとか、興味を持っ
　た理由」
dialogues.en: "I mean the reason. What made her want to be a teacher?"
dialogues.text: "I mean the reason. What made her want to be a teacher?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あにゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Anyaah..."
dialogues.text: "Anyaah..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「いや、昔見たテレビの先生がかっこ良かった
　んだよ。問題抱えててもがんばってる姿が」
dialogues.en:
"Actually, the teacher in a TV program I saw was so cool. I
liked her positive attitude, even thought she had so many
troubles."
dialogues.text:
"Actually, the teacher in a TV program I saw was so cool. I
liked her positive attitude, even thought she had so many
troubles."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ふ〜ん」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp:
音夢が意外に普通の答えだね、と頷くが、俺も
同じ意見だった。
dialogues.en:
Nemu nods, as if to say it was a very ordinary answer. I
think so, too.
dialogues.text:
Nemu nods, as if to say it was a very ordinary answer. I
think so, too.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ねぇ、お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Hey, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Hey, oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「明日から、一緒に学校に行こうよ♪」
dialogues.en: "We can go to school together again."
dialogues.text: "We can go to school together again."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 呟いて、なぜか音夢のほうを見てしまう。
dialogues.en: Startled, I involuntarily look at Nemu.
dialogues.text: Startled, I involuntarily look at Nemu.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あははは。私は構わないよ」
dialogues.en: "Hahahaha, I don't mind."
dialogues.text: "Hahahaha, I don't mind."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え、あ、うん……」
dialogues.en: "Uhh, yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Uhh, yeah..."

dialogues.jp: まぁ、別に拒否する理由もないか。
dialogues.en: Well, there is no reason to refuse.
dialogues.text: Well, there is no reason to refuse.

dialogues.jp: 「分かったよ」
dialogues.en: "All right."
dialogues.text: "All right."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「Ｒｅａｌｌｙ？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そのかわり……学園では公私混同はなしだぞ」
dialogues.en:
"But in exchange... You don't mix private and public matters
at school."
dialogues.text:
"But in exchange... You don't mix private and public matters
at school."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Okay!"
dialogues.text: "Okay!"

dialogues.jp:
さくらはそれこそ、学生と同じようなノリで手
を挙げて喜ぶ。
dialogues.en: Sakura's very excited, raising her hands like a student.
dialogues.text: Sakura's very excited, raising her hands like a student.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「がんばってね、｛・・・・・／お兄ちゃん｝」
dialogues.en: "Good luck, 'oniichan'."
dialogues.text: "Good luck, 'oniichan'."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、大変だろうけどな」
dialogues.en: "I know it's not gonna be easy."
dialogues.text: "I know it's not gonna be easy."

dialogues.jp:
兄妹でちょっとしたコンタクトをとりつつ、さ
くらの笑顔に思わず頬がゆるんだ。
dialogues.en:
We exchange glances, a brother and a sister made happy by
Sakura's smile.
dialogues.text:
We exchange glances, a brother and a sister made happy by
Sakura's smile.

dialogues.jp: ◆団欒のひと時◆
dialogues.en: ◆Enjoying each other's company◆
dialogues.text: ◆Enjoying each other's company◆

dialogues.jp:
さくらの夢が叶った祝いをかねて、音夢と３人
で夕食を一緒に食べる。
dialogues.en:
The three of us ate dinner together to celebrate Sakura
getting the job she'd dreamed of.
dialogues.text:
The three of us ate dinner together to celebrate Sakura
getting the job she'd dreamed of.

dialogues.jp:
音夢も機嫌よく、さくらから看護師になれるよ
と励まされる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu was in a good mood, and Sakura encouraged her that she
will be a nurse someday.
dialogues.text:
Nemu was in a good mood, and Sakura encouraged her that she
will be a nurse someday.

dialogues.jp:
これから先の学園生活は大変だろうけど、なぜ
か面白いこともありそうな俺だった。
dialogues.en:
I know there'll be some chaos but also fun stuff waiting for
us in our campus life.
dialogues.text:
I know there'll be some chaos but also fun stuff waiting for
us in our campus life.
